worldcombat.skill.overdrive.summary: Plants its feet, lifts the instrument and strums three times along the aim: every strum rolls a charged wall of sound from where it stands, re-aiming is allowed between strums, and each foe in the lane takes a heavy hit, is knocked back, and may be stunned into paralysis. With Echo on, the action winds down after the third strum and the heavier late echo replays on the third strum's own lane instead of chasing anyone.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.0: Hit three times down one line to pin foes standing in a row
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.1: Gamble on paralysis with charged sound
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.2: Knock a foe at the end of the lane back through cover
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.3: Turn on Echo to seal the passage a foe is chasing through
Three strums: each pushes a lane from where the user stands along the current aim, settling about %1$s special damage on every foe in it and rolling a %2$s paralysis, hitting at most %3$s foes per strum; the target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The lane runs %1$s blocks long and %2$s blocks to each side, and the strums are %3$s apart; while held you may turn between strums. It ignores cover and the ground, shaking exactly the lane it draws.

Each strum shoves those in the lane up to %1$s blocks along it; a target that is stunned is paralysed for %2$s, moving at half speed with a 25%% chance to fail each attempt, and Electric types cannot be paralysed.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.echo.on: Echo on: the action winds down after the third strum so you can keep moving, and about 1.1 s later a late echo replays on that third lane for %1$s × power, sweeping the same lane again with the same shove and another paralysis roll; each strum is about ×0.82 power with +8 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.echo.off: Echo off: three tight strums, cast and cooled down faster, to get in and out quickly.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.timing: Reaches %1$s blocks down a lane; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.growth.0: At level %1$s each strum rises to %2$s, the lane reaches %3$s blocks, and the paralysis chance rises to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.preference.e: On: the action winds down after the third strum, then a heavier late echo replays on that third lane (each strum about ×0.82 power, the total spread over more hits), one more paralysis roll, cooldown +8 ticks, to gamble on the status or seal the path a foe is chasing through. Off: three tight strums, cast and cooled down faster, to get in and out quickly.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.preference.a: The companion only considers Overdrive when a threat is this close; lower it to strum only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
At least this many visible foes must stand in the lane direction before it fires; raise it to strum only into a row and save PP, set it to 1 to strum at a single target.
